page.layout: One page of text, single column. Running head at the top, with the printed page number at the right. Heading "SPEI DATÆ FUNDAMENTA." centred. Numbered paragraph "1." with a decorative block at its start. Signature and catchword at the foot, at left and right. No marginal notes.

main_text.l: nus Regis, conspiciatur in templo Dei. Apoc. 11: 19.
Hic conspectus Jehovæ in templo suo sancto notatur
ut causa movens ad illud silentium; quia illa regni
Jehovæ cognitio evidens, primaque ejus observatio,
non potest non-adigere homines ad timorem & reverentiam, &
per consequens ad silentium subjectionis & auscultati-
onis, quâ se huic disciplinæ humiles committant.
SPEI DATÆ
FUNDAMENTA.
1. Portet & hic fateri, nondum venisse feli-
cem illum diem, quo totus orbis se
cum silentio Regi isti cœlesti submiserit; eo quod
nondum omnes ad conspectum gloriæ Jehovæ
in templo suo sancto sunt admissi. Interim tenemus
nos (qui credimus) quod revera Christus Dominus

l.i: noster, adscendens in cœlum, sedeat ut Rex, à dextera
Patris omnipotentis, & regnet ut Jehovah in

main_text.l: sancto suo palatio: quod credimus propter testes adscensionis
ejus in cœlum, & missionis Spiritus Sancti
super Apostolos; nec non propter opera ejus regia, admini-
strationem Christi regiam in regno cœlorum testifican-
tia: quicquid enim hactenus in certaminibus ecclesiæ
cum mundo, diabolo & Antichristo, cæterisque hostibus
ecclesiæ, tum fidelibus evenit (convenienter prophe-
tiis, fata regni Christi post Regis exaltationem futura
præcinentibus) hoc omne probat Christum regnare

page.notes: The decorative block at the start of paragraph 1 is an ornamental initial and is not transcribed as a letter. The signature "Sff 3" is uncertain at its second letter. The running head is taken from the top line without the page number. The heading level is an inference: it is a division title inside chapter II.
